title: Netflix Begins Production on Elite Force Season 2
excerpt:
Tomer Sisley returns for the French action thriller’s second season.
The first season reached Netflix’s Top 10 in 91 countries.
body_md:
Created by Julien Leclercq and Sylvain Caron, with Leclercq directing, Elite Force spent four weeks on Netflix’s global Top 10 chart for non-English-language television. Its presence in national Top 10 charts across 91 countries demonstrates the international reach of the French production.

The second season follows David and Max after their dismissal from GIGN, France’s specialist counterterrorism and hostage rescue unit. A new incident places the pair at the center of growing suspicion within the organization and threatens its continued existence. Further details about the incident have not been disclosed.

Announcing the start of filming, Leclercq expressed enthusiasm about returning to the series and described a new storyline with heightened intrigue, emotion and action. His comments establish the creative ambitions for the season rather than revealing specific plot developments.

The subject is familiar territory for the filmmaker. His 2011 film The Assault explored a major GIGN operation, and his subsequent Netflix work includes The Wages of Fear and the crime series Ganglands, which ran for two seasons and drew inspiration from his earlier thriller Braqueurs.

Sisley is known for the Largo Winch franchise and the French procedural Balthazar, which ran for five seasons on TF1. Elite Force joins a broader slate of French Netflix action productions that includes AKA and Under Paris. A release date for the second season was not announced in the production report.
